title: Chapter 480
text:
The energy fluctuations of the two Calamity Grade Supers wantonly spread out, and Han Xiao felt a sharp pain in his forehead. His instincts were warning him like crazy, and he felt a strong sense of danger. In the energy detection vision of the mechanical suit's helmet, every cell in Anur and Ashes' body was emitting energy arcs like solar prominences, constantly providing them with a huge amount of energy. They were like countless high-energy reactors, absorbing energy from their cells and using it as fuel to activate their Esper Abilities.

The energy reaction of a Grade A Super far exceeded that of all the Grade Bs present. The image formed by the two of them on the energy level spectrometer was like the difference between a burning fire and the flame of a lighter. Only Nagojin could compete with the two of them, and Han Xiao's energy reaction was far from the three Calamity Grade Supers. This was the difference in their energy levels.

The collapse of the building turned the street into a mess, and the shockwave blew past everyone's body. Han Xiao breathed slowly, trying to calm himself down as his brain worked quickly.

The situation is very bad now. Dark-star is out in full force. If the two Calamity Grade Supers decide to work together to get rid of us first, although we'll be able to buy time for Ovenn, many people will definitely die here. Although I'll be able to escape unscathed, Herlous, Sylvia, and the others will be in great danger. They might die in the hands of Ashes, and the losses will be too great. Ovenn is already escaping, and Dark-star's main goal is to kill the traitor. Seeing that the traitor is not here, there's more than a fifty percent chance that they'll split up and chase after him. Ovenn hasn't gone too far, and the enemy can see that the target is close by. This should make them think that we're afraid of them chasing after Ovenn …

As expected, Anur scanned the area and did not find the traitor. His heart sank, and he looked into the distance. He saw an aircraft that was escaping crazily between the gaps of the building, and the pilot was Ovenn.

"I see them!"

The bone tubes on Anur's back spewed out sharp air currents. Just as he was about to speed up and chase after them, Han Xiao shouted in a voice that everyone could hear, "Stop them!"

Bang!

Nagakin leaped forward and crashed into Anur's body midway. The wind pressure shield was almost shattered, and the two of them flew out together in midair. Like a speeding arrow, they left a trail of air behind them and pierced through the four buildings in front of them.

Anur was instantly entangled.

On the ground, the mercenaries and DarkStar clashed fiercely. Light flashed continuously, and explosions rang out one after another. The battle had begun!

Hum!

Electric currents flashed all over Han Xiao's body, and the mechanical beasts pounced out. Black Panther Type, Ranger Type, and Spider Type shuttled through the chaotic battlefield to assist the other mercenaries. One hundred and seventy-eight turrets were deployed, forming a dense net of laser beams. Three unmanned Amphiptere mechanical suits controlled by Philip joined the battle.

In an instant, Han's's's firepower, ','s,'s!

Han Xiao ''s, Han, of, of him, of his of the Supers,, of the of the of the Calamity!

Ka la la!

Countless thick gray alloy plates spread out and were attracted to the various parts of the Void Dragon mechanical suit. Han Xiao's body size rapidly increased, and he turned into a five to six-meter-tall medium armor. The armor was extremely thick, and even the weak joints were covered with round heavy armor. He looked like a heavy infantryman, giving off the feeling that he could move mountains. The halo array and the sonic sphere floated behind the medium armor, forming two rings, one large and one small.

Assault Form — Second Strengthened Version!

After obtaining High-End Knowledge, Han Xiao had strengthened the energy source of the exoskeleton assault armor, increasing its power and increasing its size. His body was in the center of the assault armor, and he could control this medium exoskeleton armor through his senses.

The propellers on his back, calves, and feet worked at the same time, pushing the assault armor into the sky. Han Xiao punched out with both fists, and his steel fists brought with them strong wind pressure.

"You again." Ashes's wound was still hurting. He was furious, and a large black cloud turned into a diamond shield.

Dong!

The steel fists hit the diamond shield, and the vibrators on his wrists turned the force of the collision into a shockwave that quickly entered the diamond shield. The next moment, Ashes's shield cracked and shattered, turning back into particles.

Ashes's eyes were cold, and he was about to attack with all his might. At this time, Anur, who was fighting with Nagojin, shouted, "They want to stop us from chasing the traitor. The traitor is our target. I'll hold them back. Don't be held back, quickly chase after them!"

Hearing this, Ashes's expression changed, and he glared at Han Xiao.

"You're lucky. I don't have time to play with you. Get out of my way!"

The mission was more important, so Ashes suppressed his killing intent. The black cloud turned into a giant snake and carried him away from the battlefield, chasing after the fleeing Ovenn. The buildings in front of him collapsed one after another.

The rumbling continued without end, and smoke and dust billowed. Waves of tremors rose one after another.

The aftermath of the battle had already spread out, and the damaged area was constantly expanding. The passersby and onlookers hurriedly moved away. Recently, there had been many incidents of destruction, and the security team was always on alert. At this time, more than two hundred security team aircraft appeared, but they happened to be in the path of Ashes. They were all swallowed by the black cloud and turned into piles of scrap metal in a few seconds. The security personnel inside were all squeezed to death.

More than two hundred security team combat aircraft were killed instantly!

Han Xiao pretended that he could not stop them and shot a dozen small missiles in the direction of Ashes. Looking at Ashes's figure that was quickly moving away, he secretly heaved a sigh of relief. The two Dark-star Calamity Grade Supers were separated, so their risk was much lower. Ovenn could only rely on himself.

With a glance at the ground, the entire street was almost completely in ruins. The terrain was complex, and the mercenaries and Dark-star warriors were fighting fiercely, splitting the area into many small battlefields. In the sky, Anur and Nagojin were having a great time fighting, crashing through buildings one after another. The shockwave created by the collision was the trajectory of the two of them.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Ashes is chasing after them, but Anur, who is good at speed, is being held back. The situation is not that bad. At least, Ovenn will not be caught so quickly. Anur might be able to escape, but the other Dark-star warriors will not be able to escape like him. The moment he leaves, Nagojin will be able to kill all these Dark-star warriors, so he will not do that!

"The only problem is that Anur is very strong, and his ability is very troublesome. He is almost invincible against us." Han Xiao frowned. He knew that Nagojin needed his help.

With that in mind, Han Xiao took out his self-made heavy laser rifle and moved toward Anur while shooting.

…

Rumble!

The sound of the buildings collapsing behind them was like a death knell. Ovenn's face was covered in sweat, and he accelerated the aircraft to Mach 1.3, which was far beyond the safety standard of an aircraft. The transparent shield protecting the pilot was trembling non-stop, as though it was going to break at any time.

A normal aircraft had a safety valve installed, and its speed was at most three hundred and fifty kilometers per hour. However, in the short preparation time before the Dark-star attack, Han Xiao took advantage of the advantage of being a Mechanic and removed the safety valve of this aircraft. He then replaced it with a backup engine for the Car Ball so that Ovenn could escape with this modified aircraft.

"Ashes is not slower than me, and he does not need to avoid the buildings. If this continues, he will catch up to me in fifteen minutes!" Ovenn gritted his teeth. "Do you have any ideas?"

Aroshia did not reply. Her arm turned into an energy shield to protect the aircraft. She did not care about Ovenn's life and death. She only wanted to complete Han Xiao's order.

Ovenn continued, "Time is too tight. The teleportation mage you mentioned is in City 8. If we maintain our current speed, we should be able to reach there in fifteen minutes, but Ashes will catch up soon …"

Aroshia turned a deaf ear to him. She was lost in thought.

In the distance, Ashes was hot on her heels.

Between the complicated buildings, a black snake was rampaging, chasing after the aircraft that kept changing its route.

…

The recent incidents of destruction had attracted the attention of the Noriose financial group. The battle this time was even more intense. The management of Noriose received the news immediately and held an emergency video conference.

"… Most of the troublemakers are Godora's people. Our system has verified the identity of one of the Grade A Supers. He is a senior officer of Godora's War Bureau, Nagojin. His opponent's background is unknown, and he must have used a fake identity when he landed. However, since he is an enemy of Godora, our guess is that he is most likely a member of Dark-star. Other than the two parties, we have also discovered the presence of Black Star. He is also involved and is on Godora's side."

The upper echelons of the financial group had a headache. These people were not to be trifled with.

"They are still fighting, and the area of destruction is still expanding. We have to stop them. I suggest we implement the third emergency plan. Let the guard fleet from outer space enter the atmosphere and intervene in the battle!"

"I object. If the two parties do not compromise, the Grade A Supers will attack the fleet, and it will only cause our losses to be greater. I suggest we let the Guardians take action and let their Supers handle this matter. Let them help Godora deal with the Grade A Supers from Dark-star. We cannot stand on the side of these terrorists. At the same time, I suggest we activate the city's protective shield to reduce the losses."

"I agree with most of the suggestions, but there is one that needs to be changed. After the Guardians arrive, they cannot intervene in the battle between the two parties. Instead, they can monitor the destruction of their battle. Noriose has always been neutral. Whether it is Godora or Dark-star, siding with either side will cause trouble. Let them fight it out themselves. The Guardians can only intervene when the Grade A Supers from both sides are about to be killed. Don't let anyone from either organization die in our territory. By the way, we cannot let Black Star die either. I don't want Ames to throw Floating Dragon Island at us.

This group of people chose Noriosse as their battlefield, so we can only consider ourselves unlucky. Losses are inevitable, so let's not create any more trouble. Let's draw a region for them to fight in. Anyway, we have already bought insurance for this planet. "

"I agree." "Seconded."

The upper echelons nodded.
